headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: HMWSSB Plans Additional 21 MGD Water Supply From Osman Sagar.
83.5 lakh people to vote in second phase of panchayat polls in Andhra Pradesh today.
2 sadguru healthcare executives held in egg racket.
1,468 polling stations set up for second phase of polls in NTR district.
Elaborate Arrangements for Second Phase of Panchayat Polls in Four Districts.
bullets_ur: HMWSSB ka Osman Sagar se mazeed 21 MGD pani ki farahmi ka mansoba.
Andhra Pradesh mein panchayat intikhabat ke doosre marhalay mein aaj 83.5 lakh log vote dalenge.
2 Sadguru Healthcare Executives ko Egg Racket ke silsile mein giraftar kiya gaya.
NTR district mein doosre marhalay ke intikhabat ke liye 1,468 polling station qaim kiye gaye.
Chaar districts mein panchayat intikhabat ke doosre marhalay ke liye mushkil intezamat kiye gaye.
